The '''''Bearing Lifter''''' was a modified [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. With enhanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], navigation, and [[Comm unit/Legends|communications]] systems and other stealth countermeasures, the ''Bearing Lifter'' was designed to evade long-range [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scanning. As one of thirty GR-75 medium [[Transport/Legends|transports]] stationed at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the ''Bearing Lifter'' participated in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] defeat at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]] conducted the ''Bearing Lifter''{{'s}} safe evacuation from Hoth, though it was one of just thirteen Rebel transports to survive the engagement.

==Description==
The ''Bearing Lifter'' was a ninety-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long<ref name="Technical Journal" /> [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]]<ref name="Insider 146" /> originally manufactured by [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]]<ref name="Rebel Transport Databank" /> Later modified to serve the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the ''Bearing Lifter''{{'s}} outer [[Hull/Legends|hull]] bristled with antennas and mechanism clusters for its enhanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], navigation, and [[Comm unit/Legends|communications]] systems. In addition, the transport's upper and lower hull surfaces were covered with specially-coated, heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating that absorbed most casual sensor emissions and masked the transport from long-range [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scans. Further internal stealth countermeasures served to defeat closer scans but with unreliable effectiveness.<ref name="Technical Journal" /> The ''Bearing Lifter'' was minimally armed with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]<ref name="Rebel Transport Databank" /> and equipped with [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="Insider 146" />

==History==
[[Starship/Legends|Starship]] manufacturer Gallofree Yards went bankrupt several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], with many of its remaining transports winding up in the hands of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|317|Gallofree Yards, Inc.}}</ref> The Rebellion purchased these<ref name="Rebel Transport Databank" /> outdated<ref name="New Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> transports at greatly reduced prices, but they required a good share of regular maintenance.<ref name="Rebel Transport Databank" /> The ''Bearing Lifter'' entered Rebel service by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook">The [[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Star Wars Sourcebook'']], which identifies the ''Bearing Lifter'' as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transport]], "describes the state of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Universe/Legends|universe]] at the end of the first movie, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars IV: A New Hope'']]." This [[Time/Legends|time]] period corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> and was one of the few true [[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports operating with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Rebellion reserved the ''Bearing Lifter'' and similar transports for the primary purpose of moving personnel and support equipment from one Rebel base to another in the event of evacuation.<ref name="Technical Journal" />

The ''Bearing Lifter'' was later one of<ref name="Insider 146" /> thirty Rebel GR-75 medium transports stationed at the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in which the Empire invaded the compromised High Command outpost, the Echo Base evacuation plan required the Rebel transports to survive a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] run through the waiting line of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in Hoth's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] under [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escort and covering fire from the base's [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> Despite the Empire destroying or capturing seventeen of the thirty evacuation transports during the battle,<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> which culminated in a resounding Rebel defeat,<ref name="Essential Atlas" /> [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]] of the Rebellion's [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] safely [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Bearing Lifter'' away from Hoth.<ref name="Insider 146" />

==Commanders and crew==
Remaining [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] of Blue Squadron and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] who did not man Echo Base's [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] as part of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] during the Battle of Hoth were tasked with overseeing the evacuation of the Rebels' GR-75 medium transports. Gemmer Sojan, [[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]], piloted the ''Bearing Lifter'' on its successful departure from Hoth.<ref name="Insider 146" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Bearing Lifter'' was first mentioned in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', co-authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]], and published in [[November]] [[1987]] as supplementary material for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The text uses an original concept illustration from the film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to depict the ''Bearing Lifter'' as an example of a Rebel transport.<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
